The prosecution says Feng abducted (拐卖) a woman, i.e., trafficking of women. The crime is "拐卖妇女罪". Possibly also "组织、强迫、容留、介绍卖淫罪"? No, that's about prostitution. This is trafficking for marriage? He didn't physically detain; he facilitated sale. So main charge: 拐卖妇女. Possibly also "非法买卖人口"? In Chinese law, "拐卖妇女、儿童罪" is the term. So answer: [罪名]拐卖妇女<eoa>. No other charges.
